description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides.

> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

description.zh: 要绑定标签的DDoS原生防护实例的ID列表。最多支持51个ID。
description.en: The IDs of the instances to which you want to add tags. You can specify up to 51 IDs.

description.zh: 要绑定标签的资源的类型，取值固定为**INSTANCE**，表示实例。
description.en: The type of the resource to which you want to add tags. Set the value to **INSTANCE**, which indicates instances.

description.zh: 要绑定的标签（键值对）列表。最多支持21个标签对。
description.en: The tags to add. You can specify up to 21 tags.

description.zh:
要绑定的标签键。

> 如果您设置的标签键不存在，则表示新建该标签键。
description.en:
The key of the tag to add.

> If the specified key does not exist, a key is created.

description.zh:
要绑定的标签值。

> 如果您设置的标签值不存在，则表示新建该标签值。
description.en:
The value of the tag to add.

> If the specified tag value does not exist, the tag value is created.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于为单个或多个DDoS原生防护实例绑定标签。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the TagResources operation to add tags to instances.

### Limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp tag-resources --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
